rule: Exactly one entry per model carries result_status = AUTHORITATIVE_FINAL_RESULT: the model chosen by the predefined, cross-validation-based selection and gate. A number is never authoritative because it is the highest in a table.

extended_model_crash.what_happened: The first ensemble-lab run crashed in the extended-feature step on a floating-point rounding error (a probability of 1.0000000000000002 rejected by a metric function). The traceback is in results/ensemble_lab_full.log and points at the cross-validation-only calibration study.
extended_model_crash.fix: probabilities are clipped to [0, 1] inside benchmark.clf_metrics (numerical safety only; no change to data, features, models, selection rules or thresholds)
extended_model_crash.rerun: the second run resumed from cached cross-validation results, selected the same candidate on cross-validation alone (auto:soft_equal, as in both run logs), scored the locked test ONCE (logged) and then ran the leakage canary for about four hours; the predictions file, summary and registry entry carry later timestamps only because they are written at the end of that long step

caveats: The core and 39-gene results were produced before the probability-clipping fix and were not recomputed; the fix can only change a probability that exceeded 1 by rounding error (about 1e-16).
Every candidate model was scored once on the locked test for reporting (screening tables); selection used cross-validation only.
The locked cell-line test of the drug-response model was logged twice (two benchmark runs of the same procedure).

core.reason: serving: the ensemble passed the predefined ensemble gate (CV, balanced accuracy, recall, stability, complementarity, locked test, leakage, reproducibility); its CV AUC gain over the single model is only about +0.004

extended_slot.reason: serving as the optional extended model: the pre-registered one-SE rule picks the simplest candidate within 1 SE of the best CV AUC

candidate_not_serving.reason: NOT serving: benchmarked candidate; its CV AUC is within 1 SE of the 39-gene model, so the one-SE rule keeps the simpler model. Promotion would need an explicit researcher decision

production_decision.note: Production routing follows the stored champion record; nothing in this registry changes it.

external_cohort.wording: External-cohort data were evaluated separately from the primary locked-test evaluation and were not used for model selection or the primary performance claims.
external_cohort.cohort: CPTAC-2 colon (Vasaikar et al., Cell 2019); cBioPortal study coad_cptac_2019
external_cohort.label_definition: the cohort's own clinical MSI_STATUS call (MSS / MSI-H); the TCGA training labels are MANTIS >= 0.4, so the two label definitions differ
external_cohort.independence_note: docs/DATASET.md describes the cohort as independent (different consortium and patient population). This audit verified only that no sample or patient IDs overlap with the TCGA table.
external_cohort.protocol: the model procedure is refit on development data restricted to the genes shared with the cohort, then scored; the served models themselves are not scored on the cohort
external_cohort.not_used_for: model selection, the ensemble gate, thresholds or promotion: none of select_best, cv_gate, test_gate or evaluate_promotion reads external metrics (checked in the code)
external_cohort.role_in_claims: supplementary; excluded from the primary performance claims

feature_set_provenance.wording: derived from the literature; no gene was chosen using this study's expression data or MSI labels
feature_set_provenance.construction: union of 8 core-mechanism genes (a published mechanistic review) and 27 genes from four published colorectal-cancer ferroptosis prognostic/metastasis signatures; src/ferroptosis.py reads only the literature table (data/ferroptosis_genes_literature.csv)
feature_set_provenance.not_independent_of_tcga: docs/DATASET.md states that TCGA COADREAD is the cohort used by all four source signature papers, so the panel is literature-derived but not independent of the TCGA cohort (the original selection was for prognosis/metastasis, not MSI)
feature_set_provenance.not_claimed: that the list was fixed before any modelling: the repository does not prove it (the gene files first appear in the 2026-09-06 baseline commit)

models.validation_protocol: nested stratified CV (5 outer folds x 2 repeats, inner tuning) on the development set; one locked test; all preprocessing, tuning, calibration, weights and thresholds fit inside training folds

cv_vs_locked_test_discrimination.note: Locked-test AUC is below the cross-validated AUC for every model while accuracy barely moves, because accuracy is dominated by the majority class. With 22 MSI-H test patients the AUC interval is wide, so this is reported as an observation (possible mild optimism of the cross-validated discrimination, or sampling variation), not as a finding.

locked_test.data: 9 cell lines (2368 line-drug rows) held out before any modelling
locked_test.relation_to_cv: DISJOINT from the cross-validation data: the 9 lines are not a subset of the CV result, and the two numbers must not be mixed or presented as one result

drug_response.honest_summary: Preliminary, weak predictive result. Most of the accuracy comes from knowing WHICH DRUG it is; the per-drug mean alone already scores close to it. Expression adds a modest gain in cross-validation (5.7%, better in 5 of 5 folds, 35 development cell lines) and almost none on the separate 9-cell-line locked test (0.2%, well inside its 95% interval). Use only as an exploratory computational in-vitro estimate.
